description: Personal build of HushTelegram 0.0.26 (84 patches) for Telegram 13.2.2 - the Google Play build (org.telegram.messenger, version code 73031); the base patches also support the telegram.org build. Based on SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram (GPL-3.0), plus: Vietnamese translation of the HushTelegram settings, a Quiet hours patch (silences non-service chats on a schedule), per-chat download folders in Save downloaded files, a Quiet Pack quick setup, quieter personal defaults, and an Edit history patch that keeps the pre-edit text of edited messages on-device (verified on the Google Play build). Needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK.
